text: 作为第九届中国国际进口博览会期间的重要配套活动，第九届中国石油国际合作论坛暨签约仪式在上海举行。中国石油采购签约金额超过188亿美元，较去年稳中有升。自2018年参加首届进博会以来，中国石油累计与267家国际供应商签约，总金额超1636亿美元。（上证报）
text_en: As an important supporting event during the 9th China International Import Expo, the 9th China Petroleum International Cooperation Forum and Signing Ceremony was held in Shanghai. China National Petroleum Corporation's procurement contracts totaled more than US$18.8 billion, stable with a slight increase from last year. Since participating in the first CIIE in 2018, CNPC has signed contracts with 267 international suppliers, with a total value exceeding US$163.6 billion. (Shanghai Securities News)
